opsproc.title: ADS-B OUT Function (Required for the intended route and the subsequent flights are partially or entirely conducted inside the Single European Sky)

procitem.title: Procedure to be developed in the operator’s MEL

command.para: Procedure must be established to obtain the permission from the Air Navigation Service Provider(s) when ADS-B OUT Function is required for the intended route. Alternate procedure may be established as required by Air Navigation Service Provider(s).
